record.dic_text:
01110 balaq {ba:-lak'}

字根型; TWOT - 252; 動詞

欽定本 - waste 2; 2

1) 使荒廢, 使荒涼, 毀壞
   1a) (Poel) 使荒涼 (#賽 24:1|)
   1b) (Pual) 荒廢的 (分詞) 或作實名詞, 意為"荒廢的城市" (#鴻 2:10|)
record.edic_text:
01110 balaq {baw-lak'}

a primitive root; TWOT - 252; v

AV - waste 2; 2

1) to waste, lay waste, devastate
   1a) (Poel) to make waste
   1b) (Pual) devastated (participle)
